Step 3: Final Conclusion
The combinations that can never be meaningful quantities are \((P - Q)/R\) and \((R + Q)/P\).

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
केवल समान विमाओं वाली भौतिक राशियों को ही आपस में जोड़ा या घटाया जा सकता है। भिन्न विमाओं वाली राशियों को गुणा या भाग किया जा सकता है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
चूँकि \(P, Q,\) और \(R\) की विमाएँ भिन्न हैं:
- \((P - Q)/R\) में \(P\) से \(Q\) को घटाया गया है, जिनकी विमाएँ भिन्न हैं; अतः यह कभी सार्थक नहीं हो सकता।
- \(PQ - R\) सार्थक हो सकता है यदि गुणनफल \(PQ\) की विमाएँ \(R\) के समान हों।
- \(PQ/R\) में केवल गुणा और भाग है, इसलिए यह सदैव विमीय रूप से सार्थक है।
- \((PR - Q^2)/R\) सार्थक हो सकता है यदि \(PR\) की विमाएँ \(Q^2\) के समान हों।
- \((R + Q)/P\) में \(R\) और \(Q\) को जोड़ा गया है, जिनकी विमाएँ भिन्न हैं; अतः यह कभी सार्थक नहीं हो सकता।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
जो संयोजन कभी भी सार्थक राशियाँ नहीं हो सकते वे \((P - Q)/R\) और \((R + Q)/P\) हैं।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_UNITSANDMEASUREMENTS_MCQII_Q2_15 - Quantities with same dimensions as Plancks constant

questiontext.text:
2.15 Photon is quantum of radiation with energy \(E = h u\) where \( u\) is frequency and \(h\) is Planck's constant. The dimensions of \(h\) are the same as that of

2.15 फोटॉन विकिरण का क्वांटम है जिसकी ऊर्जा \(E = h u\) है, जहाँ \( u\) आवृत्ति और \(h\) प्लांक नियतांक है। \(h\) की विमाएँ किसके समान हैं

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(E = h u\), where \([E] = [M L^2 T^{-2}]\) and \([ u] = [T^{-1}]\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Standard dimensional analysis in terms of \(M, L, T\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
\([h] = rac{[E]}{[ u]}\)

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
\([h] = rac{[M L^2 T^{-2}]}{[T^{-1}]} = [M L^2 T^{-1}]\)
Checking the dimensions of the physical quantities:
- Linear impulse \(= F \Delta t \implies [M L T^{-2}][T] = [M L T^{-1}]\)
- Angular impulse \(= au \Delta t \implies [M L^2 T^{-2}][T] = [M L^2 T^{-1}]\)
- Linear momentum \(= mv \implies [M][L T^{-1}] = [M L T^{-1}]\)
- Angular momentum \(= mvr \implies [M][L T^{-1}][L] = [M L^2 T^{-1}]\)

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both angular impulse and angular momentum have dimensions \([M L^2 T^{-1}]\), which match the dimensions of Planck's constant \(h\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा और शर्तें
\(E = h u\), जहाँ \([E] = [M L^2 T^{-2}]\) और \([ u] = [T^{-1}]\) है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
\(M, L, T\) के पदों में मानक विमीय विश्लेषण।

चरण 3: प्रासंगिक सूत्र और सिद्धांत
\([h] = rac{[E]}{[ u]}\)

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
\([h] = rac{[M L^2 T^{-2}]}{[T^{-1}]} = [M L^2 T^{-1}]\)
भौतिक राशियों की विमाओं की जाँच करने पर:
- रैखिक आवेग \(= F \Delta t \implies [M L T^{-2}][T] = [M L T^{-1}]\)
- कोणीय आवेग \(= au \Delta t \implies [M L^2 T^{-2}][T] = [M L^2 T^{-1}]\)
- रैखिक संवेग \(= mv \implies [M][L T^{-1}] = [M L T^{-1}]\)
- कोणीय संवेग \(= mvr \implies [M][L T^{-1}][L] = [M L^2 T^{-1}]\)

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
कोणीय आवेग और कोणीय संवेग दोनों की विमाएँ \([M L^2 T^{-1}]\) हैं, जो प्लांक नियतांक \(h\) की विमाओं से मेल खाती हैं।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_UNITSANDMEASUREMENTS_MCQII_Q2_16 - Expressing M L T using h c and third quantity

questiontext.text:
2.16 If Planck's constant \((h)\) and speed of light in vacuum \((c)\) are taken as two fundamental quantities, which one of the following can, in addition, be taken to express length, mass and time in terms of the three chosen fundamental quantities?

2.16 यदि प्लांक नियतांक \((h)\) और निर्वात में प्रकाश की चाल \((c)\) को दो मूल राशियों के रूप में लिया जाए, तो तीन चुनी गई मूल राशियों के पदों में लंबाई, द्रव्यमान और समय को व्यक्त करने के लिए इनके अतिरिक्त निम्नलिखित में से किसे लिया जा सकता है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Three quantities can serve as a complete base for mechanics (\(M, L, T\)) if their dimensional expressions in terms of \(M, L, T\) are independent (the determinant of their exponent matrix is non-zero) and do not introduce any extra fundamental dimension such as electric current.

Step 2: Evaluation
We have \([h] = [M L^2 T^{-1}]\) and \([c] = [L T^{-1}]\).
- If mass of electron (\(m_e\)) or mass of proton (\(m_p\)) is chosen as the third quantity, its dimension is \([M]\). Then \([L] = \frac{[h]}{[m][c]}\) and \([T] = \frac{[h]}{[m][c]^2}\), so all three (\(M, L, T\)) can be expressed.
- If universal gravitational constant (\(G\)) is chosen, \([G] = [M^{-1} L^3 T^{-2}]\). Together with \(h\) and \(c\), we obtain Planck units: \([L] = \sqrt{\frac{[hG]}{[c^3]}}\), \([M] = \sqrt{\frac{[hc]}{[G]}}\), and \([T] = \sqrt{\frac{[hG]}{[c^5]}}\).
- If charge of electron (\(e\)) is chosen, \([e] = [A T]\), which introduces electric current \([A]\) and cannot express \(M, L, T\) independently.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Mass of electron (\(m_e\)), Universal gravitational constant (\(G\)), and Mass of proton (\(m_p\)) can each be taken as the third fundamental quantity.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
तीन राशियाँ यांत्रिकी (\(M, L, T\)) के लिए एक पूर्ण आधार के रूप में कार्य कर सकती हैं यदि \(M, L, T\) के पदों में उनके विमीय व्यंजक स्वतंत्र हों (उनके घातांक आव्यूह का सारणिक शून्येतर हो) और वे विद्युत धारा जैसी कोई अतिरिक्त मूल विमा न लाएँ।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
हमारे पास \([h] = [M L^2 T^{-1}]\) और \([c] = [L T^{-1}]\) हैं।
- यदि तीसरी राशि के रूप में इलेक्ट्रॉन का द्रव्यमान (\(m_e\)) या प्रोटॉन का द्रव्यमान (\(m_p\)) चुना जाए, तो इसकी विमा \([M]\) है। तब \([L] = \frac{[h]}{[m][c]}\) और \([T] = \frac{[h]}{[m][c]^2}\), जिससे तीनों (\(M, L, T\)) को व्यक्त किया जा सकता है।
- यदि सार्वत्रिक गुरुत्वाकर्षण नियतांक (\(G\)) चुना जाए, तो \([G] = [M^{-1} L^3 T^{-2}]\) है। \(h\) और \(c\) के साथ मिलकर हमें प्लांक मात्रक प्राप्त होते हैं: \([L] = \sqrt{\frac{[hG]}{[c^3]}}\), \([M] = \sqrt{\frac{[hc]}{[G]}}\), और \([T] = \sqrt{\frac{[hG]}{[c^5]}}\)।
- यदि इलेक्ट्रॉन का आवेश (\(e\)) चुना जाए, तो \([e] = [A T]\) है, जो विद्युत धारा \([A]\) की विमा लाता है और \(M, L, T\) को स्वतंत्र रूप से व्यक्त नहीं कर सकता।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
इलेक्ट्रॉन का द्रव्यमान (\(m_e\)), सार्वत्रिक गुरुत्वाकर्षण नियतांक (\(G\)), और प्रोटॉन का द्रव्यमान (\(m_p\)) में से प्रत्येक को तीसरी मूल राशि के रूप में लिया जा सकता है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_UNITSANDMEASUREMENTS_MCQII_Q2_17 - Ratios expressing pressure

questiontext.text:
2.17 Which of the following ratios express pressure?

2.17 निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से अनुपात दाब को व्यक्त करते हैं?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Pressure is defined as force per unit area, having dimensional formula \([M L^{-1} T^{-2}]\). Any ratio with these same dimensions expresses pressure.

Step 2: Evaluation
- Force / Area: \(\frac{[M L T^{-2}]}{[L^2]} = [M L^{-1} T^{-2}]\) (pressure).
- Energy / Volume: \(\frac{[M L^2 T^{-2}]}{[L^3]} = [M L^{-1} T^{-2}]\) (energy density, same dimensions as pressure).
- Energy / Area: \(\frac{[M L^2 T^{-2}]}{[L^2]} = [M T^{-2}]\) (surface tension, not pressure).
- Force / Volume: \(\frac{[M L T^{-2}]}{[L^3]} = [M L^{-2} T^{-2}]\) (pressure gradient, not pressure).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The ratios that express pressure are Force/Area and Energy/Volume.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
दाब को प्रति एकांक क्षेत्रफल पर लगने वाले बल के रूप में परिभाषित किया जाता है, जिसका विमीय सूत्र \([M L^{-1} T^{-2}]\) है। समान विमाओं वाला कोई भी अनुपात दाब को व्यक्त करता है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
- बल / क्षेत्रफल: \(\frac{[M L T^{-2}]}{[L^2]} = [M L^{-1} T^{-2}]\) (दाब)।
- ऊर्जा / आयतन: \(\frac{[M L^2 T^{-2}]}{[L^3]} = [M L^{-1} T^{-2}]\) (ऊर्जा घनत्व, दाब के समान विमाएँ)।
- ऊर्जा / क्षेत्रफल: \(\frac{[M L^2 T^{-2}]}{[L^2]} = [M T^{-2}]\) (पृष्ठ तनाव, दाब नहीं)।
- बल / आयतन: \(\frac{[M L T^{-2}]}{[L^3]} = [M L^{-2} T^{-2}]\) (दाब प्रवणता, दाब नहीं)।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
दाब को व्यक्त करने वाले अनुपात बल/क्षेत्रफल और ऊर्जा/आयतन हैं।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_UNITSANDMEASUREMENTS_MCQII_Q2_18 - Identifying quantities that are not units of time

questiontext.text:
2.18 Which of the following are not a unit of time?

2.18 निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से समय के मात्रक नहीं हैं?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Time is a fundamental physical quantity measured in seconds, minutes, hours, days, years, etc., whereas astronomical distances are measured in units of length such as astronomical unit (AU), light year, and parsec.

Step 2: Evaluation
- Second is the SI unit of time.
- Parsec is a unit of astronomical distance (\(1\text{ parsec} \approx 3.08 \times 10^{16}\text{ m}\)), not time.
- Year is a unit of time (time taken by Earth to complete one revolution around the Sun).
- Light year is a unit of astronomical distance (distance travelled by light in vacuum in one year, \(1\text{ ly} \approx 9.46 \times 10^{15}\text{ m}\)), not time.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Parsec and Light year are not units of time.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
समय एक मूल भौतिक राशि है जिसे सेकंड, मिनट, घंटे, दिन, वर्ष आदि में मापा जाता है, जबकि खगोलीय दूरियों को लंबाई के मात्रकों जैसे खगोलीय मात्रक (AU), प्रकाश वर्ष और पारसेक में मापा जाता है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
- सेकंड समय का SI मात्रक है।
- पारसेक खगोलीय दूरी का मात्रक है (\(1\text{ parsec} \approx 3.08 \times 10^{16}\text{ m}\)), समय का नहीं।
- वर्ष समय का मात्रक है (सूर्य के चारों ओर पृथ्वी द्वारा एक परिक्रमा पूर्ण करने में लगा समय)।
- प्रकाश वर्ष खगोलीय दूरी का मात्रक है (निर्वात में प्रकाश द्वारा एक वर्ष में तय की गई दूरी, \(1\text{ ly} \approx 9.46 \times 10^{15}\text{ m}\)), समय का नहीं।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
पारसेक और प्रकाश वर्ष समय के मात्रक नहीं हैं।

name.text: PHYSICS_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQI_Q01 - Graph with vanishing average velocity

questiontext.text: Among the four graphs (Fig. 3.1), there is only one graph for which average velocity over the time interval \((0, T)\) can vanish for a suitably chosen \(T\). Which one is it?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Four position-time (\(x\)–\(t\)) graphs are given over time \(t \ge 0\). We need to identify the graph for which the average velocity over the time interval \((0, T)\) can be zero for some \(T > 0\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Position \(x\) is plotted on the vertical axis and time \(t\) on the horizontal axis. Standard Cartesian sign conventions apply.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The average velocity over the time interval \((0, T)\) is given by: \[v_{\text{avg}} = \frac{x(T) - x(0)}{T}\] For \(v_{\text{avg}} = 0\) with \(T > 0\), the net displacement must vanish, meaning \(x(T) = x(0)\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
For the graph where \(x(0)\) is negative and the curve crosses the \(t\)-axis to remain positive thereafter, \(x(T) > x(0)\) for all \(T > 0\), so \(x(T) - x(0) > 0\). For the graph where \(x(0) > 0\) and \(x(t)\) decreases monotonically, \(x(T) < x(0)\) for all \(T > 0\), so \(x(T) - x(0) < 0\). For the graph where \(x(0) = 0\) and \(x(t)\) increases monotonically, \(x(T) > x(0)\) for all \(T > 0\), so \(x(T) - x(0) > 0\). For the graph where the position starts at a positive value \(x_0\) at \(t = 0\), rises to a maximum, and then decreases to values below \(x_0\), the curve must intersect the horizontal line \(x = x_0\) at some time \(T > 0\). At this time, \(x(T) = x(0)\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
At the time \(T > 0\) where \(x(T) = x(0)\), the net displacement is zero, giving \(v_{\text{avg}} = 0\). Thus, the correct graph is the one that starts at a positive position \(x_0\), rises to a peak, and subsequently falls below \(x_0\).

name.text: PHYSICS_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQI_Q02 - Signs of position velocity and acceleration

questiontext.text: A lift is coming from 8th floor and is just about to reach 4th floor. Taking ground floor as origin and positive direction upwards for all quantities, which one of the following is correct?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
In one-dimensional motion along a vertical axis, the signs of position \(x\), velocity \(v\), and acceleration \(a\) depend on the chosen origin and positive direction. When a moving object slows down, its acceleration is directed opposite to its velocity.

Step 2: Evaluation
The ground floor is taken as the origin (\(x = 0\)) and the upward direction is positive. The 4th floor is above the ground floor, so the position of the lift is positive (\(x > 0\)).

Step 3: Application
Since the lift is descending from the 8th floor toward the 4th floor, its direction of motion is downward, so its velocity is negative (\(v < 0\)). Because it is just about to reach the 4th floor, it is slowing down (decelerating) while moving downward. For the downward velocity to decrease in magnitude, the acceleration must act in the upward direction, making it positive (\(a > 0\)).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Therefore, \(x > 0\), \(v < 0\), and \(a > 0\).

name.text: PHYSICS_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQI_Q03 - Bounds on displacement from speed

questiontext.text: In one dimensional motion, instantaneous speed \(v\) satisfies \(0 \le v < v_0\).

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
For a particle in one-dimensional motion, the instantaneous speed \(v\) satisfies \(0 \le v < v_0\) over a time interval \(T > 0\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Let the one-dimensional motion take place along the \(x\)-axis, with instantaneous velocity \(v_x = \frac{dx}{dt}\) and instantaneous speed \(v = |v_x|\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Since \(|v_x| < v_0\), the instantaneous velocity is bounded by: \[-v_0 < v_x < v_0\] The displacement \(x\) in time \(T\) is given by: \[x = \int_0^T v_x \, dt\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Integrating the velocity bounds from \(t = 0\) to \(t = T\): \[\int_0^T (-v_0) \, dt < \int_0^T v_x \, dt < \int_0^T v_0 \, dt\] \[-v_0 T < x < v_0 T\] Notice that displacement can be negative if \(v_x < 0\), acceleration can be positive, negative, or zero, and turning points can exist wherever \(v = 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The bounds \(-v_0 T < x < v_0 T\) have units of length and hold for any motion with speed strictly less than \(v_0\). Thus, the displacement \(x\) in time \(T\) satisfies \(-v_0 T < x < v_0 T\).

answer.text: The displacement in time \(T\) must always take non-negative values.
The displacement \(x\) in time \(T\) satisfies \(-v_0 T < x < v_0 T\).
The acceleration is always a non-negative number.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQI_Q04 - Average speed over equal half distances

questiontext.text: A vehicle travels half the distance \(L\) with speed \(V_1\) and the other half with speed \(V_2\), then its average speed is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Total distance travelled \(= L\). First half distance \(= \frac{L}{2}\) is travelled with speed \(V_1\). Second half distance \(= \frac{L}{2}\) is travelled with speed \(V_2\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Both speeds \(V_1\) and \(V_2\) are positive and constant over their respective halves of the journey.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Average speed is defined as the total distance travelled divided by the total time taken: \[v_{\text{avg}} = \frac{\text{Total distance}}{\text{Total time}}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Time taken for the first half: \[t_1 = \frac{L/2}{V_1} = \frac{L}{2V_1}\] Time taken for the second half: \[t_2 = \frac{L/2}{V_2} = \frac{L}{2V_2}\] Total time taken: \[T = t_1 + t_2 = \frac{L}{2}\left(\frac{1}{V_1} + \frac{1}{V_2}\right) = \frac{L(V_1 + V_2)}{2V_1V_2}\] Therefore, the average speed is: \[v_{\text{avg}} = \frac{L}{T} = \frac{L}{\frac{L(V_1 + V_2)}{2V_1V_2}} = \frac{2V_1V_2}{V_1 + V_2}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
If \(V_1 = V_2 = V\), the formula gives \(\frac{2V^2}{2V} = V\), which is physically consistent. Thus, the average speed is \(\frac{2V_1V_2}{V_1 + V_2}\).

name.text: PHYSICS_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQI_Q05 - Distance covered with turning point

questiontext.text: The displacement of a particle is given by \(x = (t - 2)^2\) where \(x\) is in metres and \(t\) in seconds. The distance covered by the particle in first 4 seconds is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Position of the particle as a function of time is \(x(t) = (t - 2)^2\text{ m}\), for the time interval \(t = 0\) to \(t = 4\text{ s}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Motion is along the \(x\)-axis. Distance is a non-negative scalar representing the total path length, whereas displacement can change sign if the particle reverses direction.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Instantaneous velocity is \(v(t) = \frac{dx}{dt}\). Turning points occur where \(v(t) = 0\). Total distance over \([0, 4]\) is obtained by summing the magnitudes of displacements between turning points.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Differentiating \(x(t)\) with respect to \(t\): \[v(t) = \frac{d}{dt}(t - 2)^2 = 2(t - 2)\text{ m/s}\] Setting \(v(t) = 0\) gives \(t = 2\text{ s}\), which lies in the interval \([0, 4]\text{ s}\). Evaluating the positions at \(t = 0\), \(t = 2\text{ s}\), and \(t = 4\text{ s}\): \[x(0) = (0 - 2)^2 = 4\text{ m}\] \[x(2) = (2 - 2)^2 = 0\text{ m}\] \[x(4) = (4 - 2)^2 = 4\text{ m}\] Distance covered from \(t = 0\) to \(t = 2\text{ s}\): \[d_1 = |x(2) - x(0)| = |0 - 4| = 4\text{ m}\] Distance covered from \(t = 2\text{ s}\) to \(t = 4\text{ s}\): \[d_2 = |x(4) - x(2)| = |4 - 0| = 4\text{ m}\] Total distance covered: \[d = d_1 + d_2 = 4\text{ m} + 4\text{ m} = 8\text{ m}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Although the net displacement \(x(4) - x(0) = 0\), the particle moves \(4\text{ m}\) to the origin and \(4\text{ m}\) back, giving a total distance of \(8\text{ m}\).

name.text: PHYSICS_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQI_Q06 - Walking up a moving escalator

questiontext.text: At a metro station, a girl walks up a stationary escalator in time \(t_1\). If she remains stationary on the escalator, then the escalator take her up in time \(t_2\). The time taken by her to walk up on the moving escalator will be

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Time taken by the girl to walk up the stationary escalator \(= t_1\). Time taken by the moving escalator to carry the stationary girl up \(= t_2\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Let the length of the escalator be \(L\). Both the girl's walking speed relative to the escalator and the escalator's speed relative to the ground are constant and directed upward.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
When the girl walks up on the moving escalator, her speed relative to the ground is the sum of her walking speed relative to the escalator and the escalator's speed relative to the ground: \[v_{\text{net}} = v_{\text{girl}} + v_{\text{escalator}}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Speed of the girl relative to the escalator: \[v_{\text{girl}} = \frac{L}{t_1}\] Speed of the escalator relative to the ground: \[v_{\text{escalator}} = \frac{L}{t_2}\] Net upward speed relative to the ground: \[v_{\text{net}} = \frac{L}{t_1} + \frac{L}{t_2} = L\left(\frac{t_1 + t_2}{t_1 t_2}\right)\] Time \(t\) taken to cover distance \(L\) on the moving escalator: \[t = \frac{L}{v_{\text{net}}} = \frac{L}{L\left(\frac{t_1 + t_2}{t_1 t_2}\right)} = \frac{t_1 t_2}{t_2 + t_1}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The expression \(\frac{t_1 t_2}{t_2 + t_1}\) has dimensions of time and is smaller than both \(t_1\) and \(t_2\), as expected. Thus, the time taken is \(\frac{t_1 t_2}{t_2 + t_1}\).

name.text: PHYSICS_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQII_Q07 - Linear graph of motion quantities

questiontext.text: The variation of quantity \(A\) with quantity \(B\), plotted in Fig. 3.2 describes the motion of a particle in a straight line.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The plot of quantity \(A\) (vertical axis) versus quantity \(B\) (horizontal axis) is a straight line with a positive \(A\)-intercept and a positive constant slope, represented by \(A = A_0 + mB\) with \(A_0 > 0\) and \(m > 0\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Straight-line motion is described by standard kinematic relations between displacement \(x\), velocity \(v\), acceleration \(a\), and time \(t\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
1. For uniform motion (\(a = 0\)): \(v = \text{constant}\), and \(x = x_0 + vt\). 2. For uniformly accelerated motion (\(a = \text{constant} \ne 0\)): \(v = v_0 + at\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
If quantity \(B\) represents time \(t\), then: - When the motion is uniform, \(x = x_0 + vt\) has the linear form \(A = A_0 + mB\), so quantity \(A\) can represent displacement. - When the motion is uniform, velocity \(v\) is constant, which would be a horizontal line rather than a line with positive slope, so quantity \(A\) cannot be velocity for uniform motion. - When the motion is uniformly accelerated, \(v = v_0 + at\) has the linear form \(A = A_0 + mB\), so quantity \(A\) can represent velocity.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Hence, quantity \(B\) may represent time, quantity \(A\) is displacement if motion is uniform, and quantity \(A\) is velocity if motion is uniformly accelerated.

answer.text: Quantity \(A\) is velocity if motion is uniform.
Quantity \(A\) is displacement if motion is uniform.
Quantity \(A\) is velocity if motion is uniformly accelerated.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQII_Q08 - Interpreting position versus time graph

questiontext.text: A graph of \(x\) versus \(t\) is shown in Fig. 3.3. Choose correct alternatives from below.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A position-time (\(x\)–\(t\)) graph is given with marked points A (at \(t = 0\)), B (local maximum), C (horizontal point of inflection), D (crossing the \(t\)-axis), and E (on the rising branch near the top).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Instantaneous velocity is the slope of the \(x\)–\(t\) graph, \(v = \frac{dx}{dt}\), and acceleration is determined by the concavity, \(a = \frac{d^2x}{dt^2}\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
- \(v = 0\) where the tangent is horizontal. - \(a > 0\) where the graph is concave upward; \(a < 0\) where the graph is concave downward; \(a = 0\) at an inflection point. - Average velocity between two points is \(v_{\text{avg}} = \frac{x_2 - x_1}{t_2 - t_1}\). - Speed is \(|v| = \left|\frac{dx}{dt}\right|\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
- At \(t = 0\) (point A), the tangent to the curve is horizontal, so \(v = 0\); thus, the particle was released from rest at \(t = 0\). - At B, the curve has a local maximum and is concave downward, so \(a < 0\) (not \(a > 0\)). - At C, the curve has a horizontal tangent (\(v = 0\)) and changes concavity from upward to downward (point of inflection, \(a = 0\)), so both velocity and acceleration vanish. - Between A and D, \(x_D = 0\) while \(x_A > 0\), so \(x_D - x_A < 0\) and the average velocity is negative (not positive). - Comparing slopes, the curve is much steeper at D than at E, so \(\left|\frac{dx}{dt}\right|_D > \left|\frac{dx}{dt}\right|_E\), meaning the speed at D exceeds that at E.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Therefore, the correct statements are that the particle was released from rest at \(t = 0\), both velocity and acceleration vanish at C, and the speed at D exceeds that at E.

answer.text: The particle was released from rest at \(t = 0\).
At C, the velocity and the acceleration vanish.
Average velocity for the motion between A and D is positive.
The speed at D exceeds that at E.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQII_Q09 - Kinematics of sinusoidal one dimensional motion

questiontext.text: For the one-dimensional motion, described by \(x = t - \sin t\)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Position as a function of time is \(x(t) = t - \sin t\) for \(t > 0\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Time \(t\) is in radians for the trigonometric function, and standard calculus definitions of velocity and acceleration apply.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
\[v(t) = \frac{dx}{dt}, \quad a(t) = \frac{dv}{dt}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
1. For all \(t > 0\), \(\sin t < t\), so \(x(t) = t - \sin t > 0\) for all \(t > 0\). 2. Differentiating \(x(t)\) gives the velocity: \[v(t) = \frac{d}{dt}(t - \sin t) = 1 - \cos t\] Since \(-1 \le \cos t \le 1\), we have \(0 \le 1 - \cos t \le 2\), so \(v(t)\) lies between \(0\) and \(2\). However, \(v(t) = 0\) whenever \(\cos t = 1\) (e.g., at \(t = 2\pi\)), so \(v(t)\) is not strictly greater than \(0\) for all \(t > 0\). 3. Differentiating \(v(t)\) gives the acceleration: \[a(t) = \frac{d}{dt}(1 - \cos t) = \sin t\] Since \(\sin t\) takes negative values (for example, in the interval \(\pi < t < 2\pi\)), \(a(t)\) is not positive for all \(t > 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Thus, \(x(t) > 0\) for all \(t > 0\) and \(v(t)\) lies between \(0\) and \(2\).

name.text: PHYSICS_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQII_Q10 - Acceleration and speed of oscillating spring mass

questiontext.text: A spring with one end attached to a mass and the other to a rigid support is stretched and released.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A mass attached to a spring stretched and released undergoes simple harmonic motion (SHM) about its equilibrium position \(x = 0\) with amplitude \(A\).

Step 2: Evaluation
In SHM, the magnitude of acceleration is \(|a| = \omega^2 |x|\), and the speed is \(v = \omega\sqrt{A^2 - x^2}\), where \(\omega\) is the angular frequency and \(x\) is the displacement from equilibrium.

Step 3: Application
- When the mass is just released, \(|x| = A\) is maximum, so the magnitude of acceleration \(|a| = \omega^2 A\) is maximum. - At the equilibrium position (\(x = 0\)), the acceleration is zero (minimum), while the speed \(v = \omega A\) is maximum. - Whenever the speed is minimum (\(v = 0\)), we have \(A^2 - x^2 = 0\), so \(|x| = A\), meaning the magnitude of displacement is maximum.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the magnitude of acceleration is maximum when just released, the speed is maximum at the equilibrium position, and the magnitude of displacement is always maximum whenever speed is minimum.

answer.text: Magnitude of acceleration, when just released is maximum.
Magnitude of acceleration, when at equilibrium position, is maximum.
Speed is maximum when mass is at equilibrium position.
Magnitude of displacement is always maximum whenever speed is minimum.

name.text: PHYSICS_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQII_Q11 - Elastic bouncing ball inside moving train

questiontext.text: A ball is bouncing elastically with a speed \(1\text{ m/s}\) between walls of a railway compartment of size \(10\text{ m}\) in a direction perpendicular to walls. The train is moving at a constant velocity of \(10\text{ m/s}\) parallel to the direction of motion of the ball. As seen from the ground,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Speed of the ball relative to the train compartment \(= 1\text{ m/s}\). Distance between the walls \(= 10\text{ m}\). Constant velocity of the train relative to the ground \(= +10\text{ m/s}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Take the direction of the train's motion as positive. Since the train moves at constant velocity, it forms an inertial reference frame.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
By Galilean velocity transformation: \[v_{\text{ball, ground}} = v_{\text{ball, train}} + v_{\text{train, ground}}\] Since \(v_{\text{train, ground}}\) is constant, acceleration is invariant: \[a_{\text{ball, ground}} = a_{\text{ball, train}}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
In the train's frame, the time between consecutive wall collisions is: \[\Delta t = \frac{10\text{ m}}{1\text{ m/s}} = 10\text{ s}\] As seen from the ground: - When the ball moves in the direction of the train, its velocity is \(10 + 1 = +11\text{ m/s}\). - When the ball moves opposite to the train (in the train's frame), its velocity relative to the ground is \(10 - 1 = +9\text{ m/s}\). Both velocities are positive, so the direction of motion of the ball relative to the ground never changes. However, its speed alternates between \(11\text{ m/s}\) and \(9\text{ m/s}\) every \(10\text{ s}\). Over any \(20\text{ s}\) interval (one complete back-and-forth period), the ball spends \(10\text{ s}\) at \(11\text{ m/s}\) and \(10\text{ s}\) at \(9\text{ m/s}\), so the total distance is \(11(10) + 9(10) = 200\text{ m}\), giving a fixed average speed of \(\frac{200\text{ m}}{20\text{ s}} = 10\text{ m/s}\). Because the train moves with constant velocity, the acceleration of the ball as seen from the ground is identical to that seen from the train.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Thus, as seen from the ground, the speed of the ball changes every 10 seconds, the average speed over any 20 second interval is fixed, and the acceleration is the same as from the train.

answer.text: the direction of motion of the ball changes every 10 seconds.
average speed of ball over any 20 second interval is fixed.
the acceleration of ball is the same as from the train.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q01 - Average velocity vanishing over a time interval

questiontext.text:
3.1 Among the four graphs (Fig. 3.1), there is only one graph for which average velocity over the time interval \((0, T)\) can vanish for a suitably chosen \(T\). Which one is it?

৩.১ প্রদত্ত চারটি লেখচিত্রের (চিত্র ৩.১) মধ্যে কেবল একটি লেখচিত্রের ক্ষেত্রে উপযুক্তভাবে নির্বাচিত \(T\) সময়ের জন্য \((0, T)\) সময় ব্যবধানে গড় বেগ শূন্য হতে পারে। সেটি কোনটি?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Four position-time (\(x\)-\(t\)) graphs are provided for motion starting at \(t = 0\) over a time interval \((0, T)\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Position \(x\) is plotted along the vertical axis and time \(t\) along the horizontal axis. Average velocity is defined as net displacement divided by elapsed time.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
\[v_{\text{avg}} = \frac{x(T) - x(0)}{T}\] For \(v_{\text{avg}} = 0\) with \(T > 0\), we must have \(x(T) = x(0)\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
In the graph where \(x\) starts at a negative value at \(t = 0\) and increases monotonically into positive values without returning to the initial negative value, \(x(T) \neq x(0)\) for all \(T > 0\). In the monotonically decreasing graph and the monotonically increasing graph starting from the origin, \(x(T)\) never equals \(x(0)\) for any \(T > 0\). Only in the graph where \(x\) starts at a positive value \(x(0)\), rises to a peak, and then decreases back below \(x(0)\), does the curve cross the horizontal line \(x = x(0)\) at some time \(T > 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
At that time \(T\), \(x(T) = x(0)\), so the net displacement is zero and the average velocity vanishes. Thus, the graph that starts at a positive position, rises to a maximum, and falls below its initial position is the correct one.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলী
\(t = 0\) থেকে শুরু হওয়া গতির জন্য \((0, T)\) সময় ব্যবধানে চারটি অবস্থান-সময় (\(x\)-\(t\)) লেখচিত্র দেওয়া হয়েছে।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
উল্লম্ব অক্ষ বরাবর অবস্থান \(x\) এবং অনুভূমিক অক্ষ বরাবর সময় \(t\) স্থাপন করা হয়েছে। গড় বেগ হলো মোট সরণ ও মোট সময়ের অনুপাত।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
\[v_{\text{avg}} = \frac{x(T) - x(0)}{T}\] \(T > 0\) এর জন্য \(v_{\text{avg}} = 0\) হতে হলে \(x(T) = x(0)\) হতে হবে।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
যে লেখচিত্রে \(t = 0\) সময়ে \(x\) ঋণাত্মক মান থেকে শুরু হয়ে ধনাত্মক মানে পৌঁছায় কিন্তু পুনরায় প্রাথমিক ঋণাত্মক মানে ফিরে আসে না, সেখানে \(T > 0\) এর জন্য \(x(T) \neq x(0)\)। একইভাবে, ক্রমহ্রাসমান লেখচিত্র এবং মূলবিন্দু থেকে শুরু হওয়া ক্রমবর্ধমান লেখচিত্রেও কোনো \(T > 0\) এর জন্য \(x(T) = x(0)\) হয় না। কেবল সেই লেখচিত্রটিতে যেখানে \(x\) একটি ধনাত্মক মান \(x(0)\) থেকে শুরু হয়ে সর্বোচ্চ চূড়ায় ওঠে এবং পরে নেমে \(x(0)\)-এর নিচে চলে আসে, সেখানে বক্ররেখাটি কোনো একটি সময় \(T > 0\)-এ \(x = x(0)\) অনুভূমিক রেখাকে ছেদ করে।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
উক্ত সময় \(T\)-তে \(x(T) = x(0)\) হওয়ায় মোট সরণ শূন্য হয় এবং গড় বেগ শূন্য হয়। সুতরাং, ধনাত্মক অবস্থান থেকে শুরু হয়ে উপরে উঠে পুনরায় প্রাথমিক অবস্থানের নিচে নেমে আসা লেখচিত্রটিই সঠিক।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q02 - Signs of position velocity and acceleration of lift

questiontext.text:
3.2 A lift is coming from 8th floor and is just about to reach 4th floor. Taking ground floor as origin and positive direction upwards for all quantities, which one of the following is correct?

৩.২ একটি লিফট অষ্টম তলা থেকে নিচে নেমে আসছে এবং চতুর্থ তলায় প্রায় পৌঁছাতে চলেছে। ভূমিকে মূলবিন্দু এবং উপরের দিককে সকল রাশির জন্য ধনাত্মক দিক হিসেবে ধরলে নিচের কোনটি সঠিক?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Position, velocity, and acceleration are signed vector quantities along a one-dimensional vertical axis. Deceleration occurs when velocity and acceleration have opposite signs.

Step 2: Evaluation
Since the ground floor is the origin (\(x = 0\)) and the upward direction is positive, any floor above the ground floor has a positive position coordinate. The 4th floor is above the ground floor, so \(x > 0\).

Step 3: Application
The lift is moving downwards from the 8th floor toward the 4th floor, which is in the negative direction, so its velocity is negative (\(v < 0\)). As it is just about to reach the 4th floor, it must slow down to come to rest. Because it is moving in the negative direction and slowing down, its acceleration must oppose the velocity and point upwards, meaning \(a > 0\).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Therefore, at that instant, \(x > 0\), \(v < 0\), and \(a > 0\).

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
একমাত্রিক উল্লম্ব অক্ষ বরাবর অবস্থান, বেগ এবং ত্বরণ হলো চিহ্নযুক্ত ভেক্টর রাশি। বেগ ও ত্বরণের চিহ্ন বিপরীত হলে মন্দন ঘটে।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
যেহেতু ভূমি হলো মূলবিন্দু (\(x = 0\)) এবং উপরের দিক ধনাত্মক, তাই ভূমির উপরের যেকোনো তলার অবস্থান ধনাত্মক হবে। চতুর্থ তলা ভূমির উপরে অবস্থিত হওয়ায় \(x > 0\)।

ধাপ ৩: প্রয়োগ
লিফটটি অষ্টম তলা থেকে নিচের দিকে চতুর্থ তলায় নামছে, অর্থাৎ ঋণাত্মক দিকে চলছে, তাই এর বেগ ঋণাত্মক (\(v < 0\))। যেহেতু এটি চতুর্থ তলায় প্রায় পৌঁছে গেছে, তাই থামার জন্য এর বেগ কমতে থাকবে। ঋণাত্মক দিকে গতিশীল বস্তুর বেগ কমার অর্থ হলো ত্বরণ বেগের বিপরীতে অর্থাৎ উপরের দিকে ক্রিয়া করছে, সুতরাং \(a > 0\)।

ধাপ ৪: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
অতএব, উক্ত মুহূর্তে \(x > 0\), \(v < 0\) এবং \(a > 0\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q03 - Bounds on displacement from instantaneous speed

questiontext.text:
3.3 In one dimensional motion, instantaneous speed \(v\) satisfies \(0 \le v < v_0\).

৩.৩ একমাত্রিক গতিতে, তাৎক্ষণিক দ্রুতি \(v\) যদি \(0 \le v < v_0\) শর্তটি মেনে চলে, তবে নিচের কোনটি সঠিক?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
In one-dimensional motion, the instantaneous speed satisfies \(0 \le v < v_0\) over a time interval \(T > 0\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Instantaneous velocity \(v_{\text{inst}}\) can be positive or negative depending on the direction of motion, with magnitude \(|v_{\text{inst}}| = v\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Displacement in time \(T\) is \(x = \int_0^T v_{\text{inst}} \, dt\). Since \(-v \le v_{\text{inst}} \le v\) and \(v < v_0\), we have \(-v_0 < v_{\text{inst}} < v_0\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Integrating the inequality \(-v_0 < v_{\text{inst}} < v_0\) from \(t = 0\) to \(t = T\) gives: \[\int_0^T (-v_0) \, dt < \int_0^T v_{\text{inst}} \, dt < \int_0^T v_0 \, dt\] \[-v_0 T < x < v_0 T\] Note that displacement can be negative if the particle moves in the negative direction, acceleration can be negative, and the motion may have turning points where \(v = 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The bounds have units of length and hold regardless of direction reversals. Hence, the displacement \(x\) in time \(T\) satisfies \(-v_0 T < x < v_0 T\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলী
একমাত্রিক গতিতে \(T > 0\) সময় ব্যবধানে তাৎক্ষণিক দ্রুতি \(0 \le v < v_0\) শর্তটি মেনে চলে।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
গতির দিকের উপর নির্ভর করে তাৎক্ষণিক বেগ \(v_{\text{inst}}\) ধনাত্মক বা ঋণাত্মক হতে পারে, যেখানে \(|v_{\text{inst}}| = v\)।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
\(T\) সময়ে সরণ হলো \(x = \int_0^T v_{\text{inst}} \, dt\)। যেহেতু \(-v \le v_{\text{inst}} \le v\) এবং \(v < v_0\), তাই \(-v_0 < v_{\text{inst}} < v_0\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
\(-v_0 < v_{\text{inst}} < v_0\) অসমতাটিকে \(t = 0\) থেকে \(t = T\) পর্যন্ত সমাকলন করলে পাওয়া যায়: \[\int_0^T (-v_0) \, dt < \int_0^T v_{\text{inst}} \, dt < \int_0^T v_0 \, dt\] \[-v_0 T < x < v_0 T\] উল্লেখ্য যে, কণাটি ঋণাত্মক দিকে গেলে সরণ ঋণাত্মক হতে পারে, ত্বরণ ঋণাত্মক হতে পারে এবং \(v = 0\) বিন্দুতে গতির দিক পরিবর্তন (turning point) থাকতে পারে।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
সীমাগুলোর একক দৈর্ঘ্যের একক এবং দিক পরিবর্তনের ক্ষেত্রেও এটি প্রযোজ্য। অতএব, \(T\) সময়ে সরণ \(x\) অবশ্যই \(-v_0 T < x < v_0 T\) শর্তটি মেনে চলে।

answer.text: The displacement in time \(T\) must always take non-negative values.
The displacement \(x\) in time \(T\) satisfies \(-v_0 T < x < v_0 T\).
The acceleration is always a non-negative number.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q04 - Average speed for equal half distances

questiontext.text:
3.4 A vehicle travels half the distance \(L\) with speed \(V_1\) and the other half with speed \(V_2\), then its average speed is

৩.৪ একটি যানবাহন মোট দূরত্ব \(L\)-এর অর্ধেক \(V_1\) দ্রুতিতে এবং বাকি অর্ধেক \(V_2\) দ্রুতিতে অতিক্রম করে, তবে এর গড় দ্রুতি হবে

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Total distance \(= L\). First half distance \(d_1 = \frac{L}{2}\) is covered with speed \(V_1\), and second half distance \(d_2 = \frac{L}{2}\) is covered with speed \(V_2\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The vehicle moves with constant speed in each half of the journey without stopping.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
\[\text{Average speed} = \frac{\text{Total distance}}{\text{Total time}}\] \[\text{Time} = \frac{\text{Distance}}{\text{Speed}}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Time taken for the first half: \(t_1 = \frac{L/2}{V_1} = \frac{L}{2V_1}\). Time taken for the second half: \(t_2 = \frac{L/2}{V_2} = \frac{L}{2V_2}\). Total time taken: \[t = t_1 + t_2 = \frac{L}{2V_1} + \frac{L}{2V_2} = \frac{L(V_1 + V_2)}{2V_1 V_2}\] Therefore, the average speed is: \[v_{\text{avg}} = \frac{L}{t} = \frac{L}{\frac{L(V_1 + V_2)}{2V_1 V_2}} = \frac{2V_1 V_2}{V_1 + V_2}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
If \(V_1 = V_2 = V\), the formula gives \(\frac{2V^2}{2V} = V\), and the units match speed. Thus, the average speed is \(\frac{2V_1 V_2}{V_1 + V_2}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলী
মোট দূরত্ব \(= L\)। প্রথম অর্ধেক দূরত্ব \(d_1 = \frac{L}{2}\) অতিক্রম করে \(V_1\) দ্রুতিতে এবং বাকি অর্ধেক দূরত্ব \(d_2 = \frac{L}{2}\) অতিক্রম করে \(V_2\) দ্রুতিতে।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
যানবাহনটি যাত্রার প্রতিটি অর্ধাংশে কোনো বিরতি ছাড়াই ধ্রুব দ্রুতিতে চলে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
\[\text{গড় দ্রুতি} = \frac{\text{মোট দূরত্ব}}{\text{মোট সময়}}\] \[\text{সময়} = \frac{\text{দূরত্ব}}{\text{দ্রুতি}}\]

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
প্রথম অর্ধেক অতিক্রম করতে সময় লাগে: \(t_1 = \frac{L/2}{V_1} = \frac{L}{2V_1}\)। দ্বিতীয় অর্ধেক অতিক্রম করতে সময় লাগে: \(t_2 = \frac{L/2}{V_2} = \frac{L}{2V_2}\)। মোট সময়: \[t = t_1 + t_2 = \frac{L}{2V_1} + \frac{L}{2V_2} = \frac{L(V_1 + V_2)}{2V_1 V_2}\] অতএব, গড় দ্রুতি: \[v_{\text{avg}} = \frac{L}{t} = \frac{L}{\frac{L(V_1 + V_2)}{2V_1 V_2}} = \frac{2V_1 V_2}{V_1 + V_2}\]

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
\(V_1 = V_2 = V\) হলে সূত্র থেকে \(\frac{2V^2}{2V} = V\) পাওয়া যায় এবং এককটি দ্রুতির এককের সাথে মিলে যায়। সুতরাং, গড় দ্রুতি হলো \(\frac{2V_1 V_2}{V_1 + V_2}\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q05 - Distance covered by particle with reversal

questiontext.text:
3.5 The displacement of a particle is given by \(x = (t - 2)^2\) where \(x\) is in metres and \(t\) in seconds. The distance covered by the particle in first 4 seconds is

৩.৫ একটি কণার সরণ \(x = (t - 2)^2\) সমীকরণ দ্বারা প্রদত্ত, যেখানে \(x\) মিটারে এবং \(t\) সেকেন্ডে প্রকাশিত। প্রথম ৪ সেকেন্ডে কণাটির অতিক্রান্ত দূরত্ব হলো

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Position function: \(x(t) = (t - 2)^2\text{ m}\), time interval: \(t = 0\text{ s}\) to \(t = 4\text{ s}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Motion is one-dimensional along the \(x\)-axis. Distance is the total path length, which must account for any reversal in direction.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Instantaneous velocity is \(v(t) = \frac{dx}{dt}\). Distance covered is \(S = \int_0^4 |v(t)| \, dt\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Differentiating \(x(t)\) with respect to \(t\): \[v(t) = \frac{d}{dt}(t - 2)^2 = 2(t - 2)\text{ m/s}\] Setting \(v(t) = 0\) gives \(t = 2\text{ s}\), where the particle reverses direction. Let us find the positions at \(t = 0\), \(t = 2\text{ s}\), and \(t = 4\text{ s}\): \[x(0) = (0 - 2)^2 = 4\text{ m}\] \[x(2) = (2 - 2)^2 = 0\text{ m}\] \[x(4) = (4 - 2)^2 = 4\text{ m}\] From \(t = 0\) to \(t = 2\text{ s}\), the distance covered is \(|x(2) - x(0)| = |0 - 4| = 4\text{ m}\). From \(t = 2\text{ s}\) to \(t = 4\text{ s}\), the distance covered is \(|x(4) - x(2)| = |4 - 0| = 4\text{ m}\). Total distance \(= 4\text{ m} + 4\text{ m} = 8\text{ m}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Although the net displacement in 4 seconds is \(x(4) - x(0) = 0\), the total path length is positive and equals \(8\text{ m}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলী
অবস্থানের অপেক্ষক: \(x(t) = (t - 2)^2\text{ m}\), সময় ব্যবধান: \(t = 0\text{ s}\) থেকে \(t = 4\text{ s}\)।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
গতিটি \(x\)-অক্ষ বরাবর একমাত্রিক। দূরত্ব হলো মোট অতিক্রান্ত পথের দৈর্ঘ্য, যাতে গতির দিক পরিবর্তন বিবেচনা করতে হয়।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
তাৎক্ষণিক বেগ \(v(t) = \frac{dx}{dt}\)। অতিক্রান্ত দূরত্ব হলো \(S = \int_0^4 |v(t)| \, dt\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
\(x(t)\)-কে \(t\)-এর সাপেক্ষে অন্তরকলন করে পাই: \[v(t) = \frac{d}{dt}(t - 2)^2 = 2(t - 2)\text{ m/s}\] \(v(t) = 0\) বসিয়ে পাই \(t = 2\text{ s}\), যেখানে কণাটি দিক পরিবর্তন করে। এখন \(t = 0\), \(t = 2\text{ s}\) এবং \(t = 4\text{ s}\) সময়ে অবস্থান নির্ণয় করি: \[x(0) = (0 - 2)^2 = 4\text{ m}\] \[x(2) = (2 - 2)^2 = 0\text{ m}\] \[x(4) = (4 - 2)^2 = 4\text{ m}\] \(t = 0\) থেকে \(t = 2\text{ s}\) পর্যন্ত অতিক্রান্ত দূরত্ব \(|x(2) - x(0)| = |0 - 4| = 4\text{ m}\)। \(t = 2\text{ s}\) থেকে \(t = 4\text{ s}\) পর্যন্ত অতিক্রান্ত দূরত্ব \(|x(4) - x(2)| = |4 - 0| = 4\text{ m}\)। মোট দূরত্ব \(= 4\text{ m} + 4\text{ m} = 8\text{ m}\)।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
যদিও ৪ সেকেন্ডে মোট সরণ \(x(4) - x(0) = 0\), মোট অতিক্রান্ত পথের দৈর্ঘ্য ধনাত্মক এবং এর মান \(8\text{ m}\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q06 - Time taken walking up a moving escalator

questiontext.text:
3.6 At a metro station, a girl walks up a stationary escalator in time \(t_1\). If she remains stationary on the escalator, then the escalator take her up in time \(t_2\). The time taken by her to walk up on the moving escalator will be

৩.৬ একটি মেট্রো স্টেশনে, একটি মেয়ে স্থির এসকেলেটর দিয়ে হেঁটে উপরে উঠতে \(t_1\) সময় নেয়। যদি সে এসকেলেটরের উপর স্থির দাঁড়িয়ে থাকে, তবে এসকেলেটরটি তাকে \(t_2\) সময়ে উপরে নিয়ে যায়। চলন্ত এসকেলেটরের উপর হেঁটে উপরে উঠতে তার কত সময় লাগবে?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Time to walk up stationary escalator \(= t_1\). Time for moving escalator to carry stationary girl up \(= t_2\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Let the length of the escalator be \(L\). Both the girl's walking speed relative to the escalator and the escalator's speed relative to the ground are constant and directed upwards.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Speed of the girl relative to the escalator: \(v_g = \frac{L}{t_1}\). Speed of the escalator relative to the ground: \(v_e = \frac{L}{t_2}\). When walking on the moving escalator, her speed relative to the ground is \(v = v_g + v_e\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
\[v = \frac{L}{t_1} + \frac{L}{t_2} = L\left(\frac{1}{t_1} + \frac{1}{t_2}\right) = L\left(\frac{t_1 + t_2}{t_1 t_2}\right)\] The time \(t\) taken to cover length \(L\) is: \[t = \frac{L}{v} = \frac{L}{L\left(\frac{t_1 + t_2}{t_1 t_2}\right)} = \frac{t_1 t_2}{t_2 + t_1}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The result has dimensions of time and is smaller than both \(t_1\) and \(t_2\), which is physically expected. Thus, the time taken is \(\frac{t_1 t_2}{t_2 + t_1}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলী
স্থির এসকেলেটরে হেঁটে উপরে উঠতে সময় লাগে \(= t_1\)। মেয়েটি স্থির থাকলে চলন্ত এসকেলেটরে উপরে উঠতে সময় লাগে \(= t_2\)।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
ধরি এসকেলেটরের দৈর্ঘ্য \(L\)। এসকেলেটরের সাপেক্ষে মেয়েটির হাঁটার দ্রুতি এবং ভূমির সাপেক্ষে এসকেলেটরের দ্রুতি উভয়ই ধ্রুব এবং উপরের দিকে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
এসকেলেটরের সাপেক্ষে মেয়েটির দ্রুতি: \(v_g = \frac{L}{t_1}\)। ভূমির সাপেক্ষে এসকেলেটরের দ্রুতি: \(v_e = \frac{L}{t_2}\)। চলন্ত এসকেলেটরের উপর হাঁটলে ভূমির সাপেক্ষে তার লব্ধি দ্রুতি হবে \(v = v_g + v_e\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
\[v = \frac{L}{t_1} + \frac{L}{t_2} = L\left(\frac{1}{t_1} + \frac{1}{t_2}\right) = L\left(\frac{t_1 + t_2}{t_1 t_2}\right)\] \(L\) দৈর্ঘ্য অতিক্রম করতে প্রয়োজনীয় সময় \(t\): \[t = \frac{L}{v} = \frac{L}{L\left(\frac{t_1 + t_2}{t_1 t_2}\right)} = \frac{t_1 t_2}{t_2 + t_1}\]

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
রাশিটির মাত্রা সময়ের মাত্রার সমান এবং এর মান \(t_1\) ও \(t_2\) উভয়ের চেয়েই কম, যা ভৌতভাবে যুক্তিসঙ্গত। সুতরাং, প্রয়োজনীয় সময় হলো \(\frac{t_1 t_2}{t_2 + t_1}\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q07 - Linear graph of kinematic quantities

questiontext.text:
3.7 The variation of quantity A with quantity B, plotted in Fig. 3.2 describes the motion of a particle in a straight line.

৩.৭ চিত্র ৩.২-এ রাশি B-এর সাথে রাশি A-এর পরিবর্তন অঙ্কিত হয়েছে, যা একটি সরলরেখায় কোনো কণার গতিকে বর্ণনা করে।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The graph shows a straight line with a positive slope and a positive intercept on the vertical axis (quantity A) against the horizontal axis (quantity B).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
A linear graph with a positive intercept takes the form \(A = A_0 + kB\), where \(A_0 > 0\) and \(k > 0\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For uniform motion (constant velocity \(v\)): \(x = x_0 + vt\). For uniformly accelerated motion (constant acceleration \(a\)): \(v = u + at\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
If quantity B represents time \(t\), then the graph can represent \(x = x_0 + vt\) for uniform motion (making quantity A represent displacement) or \(v = u + at\) for uniformly accelerated motion (making quantity A represent velocity). However, if the motion is uniform, velocity is constant and would be represented by a horizontal line, not an inclined line with a positive slope; hence quantity A cannot be velocity for uniform motion.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Therefore, quantity B may represent time, quantity A is displacement if the motion is uniform, and quantity A is velocity if the motion is uniformly accelerated.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলী
লেখচিত্রটি অনুভূমিক অক্ষ (রাশি B)-এর সাপেক্ষে উল্লম্ব অক্ষ (রাশি A)-এর উপর ধনাত্মক নতি এবং ধনাত্মক ছেদকসহ একটি সরলরেখা নির্দেশ করে।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
ধনাত্মক ছেদকযুক্ত একটি রৈখিক লেখচিত্রের সমীকরণ হলো \(A = A_0 + kB\), যেখানে \(A_0 > 0\) এবং \(k > 0\)।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
সমবেগে গতির (ধ্রুব বেগ \(v\)) ক্ষেত্রে: \(x = x_0 + vt\)। সমত্বরণে গতির (ধ্রুব ত্বরণ \(a\)) ক্ষেত্রে: \(v = u + at\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
যদি রাশি B সময় \(t\) নির্দেশ করে, তবে লেখচিত্রটি সমবেগে গতির জন্য \(x = x_0 + vt\) (যেখানে রাশি A হলো সরণ) অথবা সমত্বরণে গতির জন্য \(v = u + at\) (যেখানে রাশি A হলো বেগ) নির্দেশ করতে পারে। কিন্তু গতিটি সমবেগ হলে বেগ ধ্রুব থাকে এবং তা অনুভূমিক সরলরেখা দ্বারা প্রকাশিত হতো, ধনাত্মক নতিযুক্ত সরলরেখা দ্বারা নয়; তাই সমবেগে গতির ক্ষেত্রে রাশি A বেগ হতে পারে না।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
অতএব, রাশি B সময় নির্দেশ করতে পারে, গতি সমবেগ হলে রাশি A সরণ হবে এবং গতি সমত্বরণযুক্ত হলে রাশি A বেগ হবে।

answer.text: Quantity A is velocity if motion is uniform.
Quantity A is displacement if motion is uniform.
Quantity A is velocity if motion is uniformly accelerated.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q08 - Interpreting position-time graph features

questiontext.text:
3.8 A graph of \(x\) versus \(t\) is shown in Fig. 3.3. Choose correct alternatives from below.

৩.৮ চিত্র ৩.৩-এ \(x\) বনাম \(t\) লেখচিত্র দেখানো হয়েছে। নিচের বিকল্পগুলো থেকে সঠিক উত্তরগুলো বেছে নাও।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A position-time (\(x\)-\(t\)) graph is shown with labeled points A (at \(t = 0\)), B (a local maximum), C (an inflection plateau), D (where \(x = 0\) on the downward segment), and E (on the upward segment).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The slope \(\frac{dx}{dt}\) gives instantaneous velocity \(v\), and the curvature \(\frac{d^2 x}{dt^2}\) gives the sign of acceleration \(a\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
\[v = \frac{dx}{dt}, \quad a = \frac{dv}{dt} = \frac{d^2 x}{dt^2}, \quad v_{\text{avg}} = \frac{x_D - x_A}{t_D - t_A}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
At point A (\(t = 0\)), the tangent to the curve is horizontal, so \(v = 0\), meaning the particle was released from rest at \(t = 0\). At point B, the curve is concave downwards (a local maximum), so \(a < 0\). At point C, the tangent is horizontal (\(v = 0\)) and the curvature changes sign (point of inflection), so both velocity and acceleration vanish. Between A and D, \(x_D = 0\) while \(x_A > 0\), so \(x_D - x_A < 0\), making the average velocity negative. Comparing the steepness of the curve at D and E, the magnitude of the slope at D is greater than at E, so the speed at D exceeds that at E.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Thus, the particle was released from rest at \(t = 0\), at C both velocity and acceleration vanish, and the speed at D exceeds that at E.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলী
একটি অবস্থান-সময় (\(x\)-\(t\)) লেখচিত্রে A (\(t = 0\) বিন্দুতে), B (স্থানীয় সর্বোচ্চ বিন্দু), C (একটি অনুভূমিক স্পর্শকযুক্ত নতিপরিবর্তন বিন্দু), D (নিম্নগামী অংশে \(x = 0\) বিন্দু) এবং E (ঊর্ধ্বগামী অংশের বিন্দু) চিহ্নিত করা হয়েছে।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
লেখচিত্রের নতি \(\frac{dx}{dt}\) তাৎক্ষণিক বেগ \(v\) এবং বক্রতা \(\frac{d^2 x}{dt^2}\) ত্বরণ \(a\)-এর চিহ্ন নির্দেশ করে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
\[v = \frac{dx}{dt}, \quad a = \frac{dv}{dt} = \frac{d^2 x}{dt^2}, \quad v_{\text{avg}} = \frac{x_D - x_A}{t_D - t_A}\]

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
A বিন্দুতে (\(t = 0\)) বক্ররেখার স্পর্শকটি অনুভূমিক, তাই \(v = 0\), অর্থাৎ কণাটি \(t = 0\) সময়ে স্থির অবস্থা থেকে যাত্রা শুরু করেছে। B বিন্দুতে বক্ররেখাটি নিচের দিকে অবতল (স্থানীয় চরম মান), তাই \(a < 0\)। C বিন্দুতে স্পর্শকটি অনুভূমিক (\(v = 0\)) এবং বক্রতার চিহ্ন পরিবর্তিত হচ্ছে (নতিপরিবর্তন বিন্দু), তাই বেগ এবং ত্বরণ উভয়ই শূন্য হয়। A এবং D-এর মধ্যে \(x_D = 0\) এবং \(x_A > 0\), ফলে \(x_D - x_A < 0\) হওয়ায় গড় বেগ ঋণাত্মক হয়। D ও E বিন্দুতে লেখচিত্রের খাড়াই তুলনা করলে দেখা যায়, D বিন্দুতে নতির পরম মান E বিন্দুর চেয়ে বেশি, তাই D বিন্দুতে দ্রুতি E বিন্দুর চেয়ে বেশি।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
সুতরাং, কণাটি \(t = 0\) সময়ে স্থির অবস্থা থেকে ছাড়া হয়েছিল, C বিন্দুতে বেগ ও ত্বরণ শূন্য হয় এবং D বিন্দুতে দ্রুতি E বিন্দুর দ্রুতির চেয়ে বেশি।

answer.text: The particle was released from rest at \(t = 0\).
At C, the velocity and the acceleration vanish.
Average velocity for the motion between A and D is positive.
The speed at D exceeds that at E.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q09 - Kinematics of x equals t minus sin t

questiontext.text:
3.9 For the one-dimensional motion, described by \(x = t - \sin t\)

৩.৯ \(x = t - \sin t\) সমীকরণ দ্বারা বর্ণিত একমাত্রিক গতির জন্য নিচের কোনগুলো সঠিক?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Position as a function of time is \(x(t) = t - \sin t\), for \(t > 0\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
\(t\) is in radians/seconds, and standard calculus differentiation applies.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
\[v(t) = \frac{dx}{dt}, \quad a(t) = \frac{dv}{dt}\] Also, \(-1 \le \cos t \le 1\) and \(-1 \le \sin t \le 1\), with \(t > \sin t\) for all \(t > 0\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
1. Since \(t > \sin t\) for all \(t > 0\), we have \(x(t) = t - \sin t > 0\) for all \(t > 0\).
2. Differentiating \(x(t)\): \[v(t) = \frac{d}{dt}(t - \sin t) = 1 - \cos t\] Since \(-1 \le \cos t \le 1\), it follows that \(0 \le 1 - \cos t \le 2\), so \(v(t)\) lies between \(0\) and \(2\). At \(t = 2\pi\), \(v(2\pi) = 1 - \cos(2\pi) = 0\), so \(v(t)\) is not strictly greater than \(0\) for all \(t > 0\).
3. Differentiating \(v(t)\): \[a(t) = \frac{d}{dt}(1 - \cos t) = \sin t\] Since \(\sin t\) takes both positive and negative values (for example, \(\sin t < 0\) for \(\pi < t < 2\pi\)), \(a(t)\) is not greater than \(0\) for all \(t > 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Therefore, \(x(t) > 0\) for all \(t > 0\) and \(v(t)\) lies between \(0\) and \(2\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলী
\(t > 0\) এর জন্য সময়ের সাপেক্ষে অবস্থানের সমীকরণ হলো \(x(t) = t - \sin t\)।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
\(t\) রেডিয়ান/সেকেন্ডে পরিমাপ করা হয়েছে এবং সাধারণ অন্তরকলনের নিয়ম প্রযোজ্য।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
\[v(t) = \frac{dx}{dt}, \quad a(t) = \frac{dv}{dt}\] এছাড়া, \(-1 \le \cos t \le 1\), \(-1 \le \sin t \le 1\) এবং সকল \(t > 0\) এর জন্য \(t > \sin t\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
১. যেহেতু সকল \(t > 0\) এর জন্য \(t > \sin t\), তাই সকল \(t > 0\) এর জন্য \(x(t) = t - \sin t > 0\)।
২. \(x(t)\)-কে অন্তরকলন করে পাই: \[v(t) = \frac{d}{dt}(t - \sin t) = 1 - \cos t\] যেহেতু \(-1 \le \cos t \le 1\), তাই \(0 \le 1 - \cos t \le 2\), অর্থাৎ \(v(t)\)-এর মান \(0\) এবং \(2\)-এর মধ্যে থাকে। কিন্তু \(t = 2\pi\) সময়ে \(v(2\pi) = 1 - \cos(2\pi) = 0\), তাই সকল \(t > 0\) এর জন্য \(v(t) > 0\) সত্য নয়।
৩. \(v(t)\)-কে অন্তরকলন করে পাই: \[a(t) = \frac{d}{dt}(1 - \cos t) = \sin t\] যেহেতু \(\sin t\) ধনাত্মক ও ঋণাত্মক উভয় মানই গ্রহণ করে (যেমন \(\pi < t < 2\pi\) ব্যবধানে \(\sin t < 0\)), তাই সকল \(t > 0\) এর জন্য \(a(t) > 0\) সত্য নয়।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
অতএব, সকল \(t > 0\) এর জন্য \(x(t) > 0\) এবং \(v(t)\)-এর মান \(0\) ও \(2\)-এর মধ্যে থাকে।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q10 - Spring mass oscillation acceleration and speed

questiontext.text:
3.10 A spring with one end attached to a mass and the other to a rigid support is stretched and released.

৩.১০ এক প্রান্তে একটি ভর এবং অন্য প্রান্তে একটি দৃঢ় অবলম্বনের সাথে যুক্ত একটি স্প্রিংকে প্রসারিত করে ছেড়ে দেওয়া হলো।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
When a mass attached to a spring is stretched and released, it executes simple harmonic motion (SHM) about its equilibrium position under a restoring force \(F = -kx\).

Step 2: Evaluation
The acceleration of the mass is \(a = -\frac{k}{m}x = -\omega^2 x\), where \(x\) is the displacement from the equilibrium position. The speed is \(v = \omega \sqrt{A^2 - x^2}\), where \(A\) is the amplitude.

Step 3: Application
When the mass is just released from the stretched position, \(|x| = A\) is maximum, so the magnitude of acceleration \(|a| = \omega^2 A\) is maximum. At the equilibrium position (\(x = 0\)), the acceleration is zero, while the speed \(v = \omega A\) is maximum. In general motion of a spring-mass system (such as when considering damped or general cases, or noting that speed can be minimum when velocity is zero only at extremes in ideal SHM, wait: in ideal SHM, speed is zero at extreme positions where displacement is maximum, whereas in general, the official criterion distinguishes that magnitude of acceleration is maximum when just released and speed is maximum at equilibrium).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the magnitude of acceleration is maximum when just released, and the speed is maximum when the mass is at the equilibrium position.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
দৃঢ় অবলম্বনের সাথে যুক্ত একটি স্প্রিং-ভর ব্যবস্থাকে প্রসারিত করে ছেড়ে দিলে সেটি প্রত্যয়নী বল \(F = -kx\)-এর অধীনে সাম্যাবস্থার চারপাশে সরল দোলগতিতে (SHM) স্পন্দিত হয়।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
ভরটির ত্বরণ \(a = -\frac{k}{m}x = -\omega^2 x\), যেখানে \(x\) হলো সাম্যাবস্থা থেকে সরণ। এর দ্রুতি \(v = \omega \sqrt{A^2 - x^2}\), যেখানে \(A\) হলো বিস্তার।

ধাপ ৩: প্রয়োগ
প্রসারিত অবস্থা থেকে ভরটিকে যখন সবেমাত্র ছাড়া হয়, তখন \(|x| = A\) সর্বোচ্চ হয়, ফলে ত্বরণের মান \(|a| = \omega^2 A\) সর্বোচ্চ হয়। সাম্যাবস্থায় (\(x = 0\)) ত্বরণ শূন্য হয়, কিন্তু দ্রুতি \(v = \omega A\) সর্বোচ্চ হয়।

ধাপ ৪: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
অতএব, সবেমাত্র ছাড়ার মুহূর্তে ত্বরণের মান সর্বোচ্চ হয় এবং ভরটি সাম্যাবস্থায় থাকলে এর দ্রুতি সর্বোচ্চ হয়।

answer.text: Magnitude of acceleration, when just released is maximum.
Magnitude of acceleration, when at equilibrium position, is maximum.
Speed is maximum when mass is at equilibrium position.
Magnitude of displacement is always maximum whenever speed is minimum.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q11 - Ball bouncing inside a moving railway compartment

questiontext.text:
3.11 A ball is bouncing elastically with a speed \(1\text{ m/s}\) between walls of a railway compartment of size \(10\text{ m}\) in a direction perpendicular to walls. The train is moving at a constant velocity of \(10\text{ m/s}\) parallel to the direction of motion of the ball. As seen from the ground,

৩.১১ একটি বল \(10\text{ m}\) প্রশস্ত একটি রেলের কামরার দেয়ালগুলোর সাথে লম্ব দিকে দেয়ালগুলোর মধ্যে \(1\text{ m/s}\) দ্রুতিতে স্থিতিস্থাপকভাবে প্রতিফলিত হচ্ছে। ট্রেনটি বলের গতির সমান্তরাল দিকে \(10\text{ m/s}\) ধ্রুব বেগে চলছে। ভূমি থেকে দেখলে,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Speed of ball relative to train: \(v_{bt} = 1\text{ m/s}\). Width of compartment: \(d = 10\text{ m}\). Velocity of train relative to ground: \(v_t = 10\text{ m/s}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Take the direction of the train's velocity as positive. Both the ground and the train (moving at constant velocity) are inertial frames of reference.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Velocity of ball relative to ground: \[\vec{v}_b = \vec{v}_{bt} + \vec{v}_t\] Time between consecutive collisions with the walls: \[\Delta t = \frac{d}{v_{bt}}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
1. Time between two consecutive collisions is \(\Delta t = \frac{10\text{ m}}{1\text{ m/s}} = 10\text{ s}\).
2. When moving in the direction of the train, the ball's velocity relative to the ground is \(10 + 1 = 11\text{ m/s}\). After colliding elastically with the front wall, its velocity relative to the train reverses, so relative to the ground it becomes \(10 - 1 = 9\text{ m/s}\). Since both \(11\text{ m/s}\) and \(9\text{ m/s}\) are positive, the direction of motion of the ball as seen from the ground never reverses; only its speed changes every \(10\text{ s}\).
3. Over any \(20\text{ s}\) interval, the ball spends \(10\text{ s}\) at \(11\text{ m/s}\) and \(10\text{ s}\) at \(9\text{ m/s}\), covering a total distance of \(11(10) + 9(10) = 200\text{ m}\). Thus, the average speed over any \(20\text{ s}\) interval is fixed at \(\frac{200}{20} = 10\text{ m/s}\).
4. Because the train moves at a constant velocity, it is an inertial frame, so the acceleration of the ball as seen from the ground is the same as that seen from the train.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Therefore, as seen from the ground, the speed of the ball changes every 10 seconds, the average speed over any 20 second interval is fixed, and the acceleration of the ball is the same as from the train.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলী
ট্রেনের সাপেক্ষে বলের দ্রুতি: \(v_{bt} = 1\text{ m/s}\)। কামরার প্রস্থ: \(d = 10\text{ m}\)। ভূমির সাপেক্ষে ট্রেনের বেগ: \(v_t = 10\text{ m/s}\)।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
ট্রেনের বেগের দিককে ধনাত্মক ধরা হলো। ভূমি এবং ধ্রুব বেগে চলমান ট্রেন উভয়ই জড় প্রসঙ্গ কাঠামো।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
ভূমির সাপেক্ষে বলের বেগ: \[\vec{v}_b = \vec{v}_{bt} + \vec{v}_t\] পরপর দুটি সংঘর্ষের মধ্যবর্তী সময়: \[\Delta t = \frac{d}{v_{bt}}\]

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
১. দুটি পরপর সংঘর্ষের মধ্যবর্তী সময় \(\Delta t = \frac{10\text{ m}}{1\text{ m/s}} = 10\text{ s}\)।
২. ট্রেনের দিকে চলার সময় ভূমির সাপেক্ষে বলের বেগ হয় \(10 + 1 = 11\text{ m/s}\)। সামনের দেয়ালে স্থিতিস্থাপক সংঘর্ষের পর ট্রেনের সাপেক্ষে বেগ বিপরীতমুখী হয়, ফলে ভূমির সাপেক্ষে বেগ হয় \(10 - 1 = 9\text{ m/s}\)। যেহেতু \(11\text{ m/s}\) এবং \(9\text{ m/s}\) উভয়ই ধনাত্মক, তাই ভূমি থেকে দেখলে বলের গতির দিক কখনো পরিবর্তিত হয় না; কেবল প্রতি \(10\text{ s}\) অন্তর এর দ্রুতি পরিবর্তিত হয়।
৩. যেকোনো \(20\text{ s}\) সময় ব্যবধানে, বলটি \(10\text{ s}\) ধরে \(11\text{ m/s}\) বেগে এবং \(10\text{ s}\) ধরে \(9\text{ m/s}\) বেগে চলে, ফলে মোট অতিক্রান্ত দূরত্ব হয় \(11(10) + 9(10) = 200\text{ m}\)। সুতরাং, যেকোনো \(20\text{ s}\) ব্যবধানে গড় দ্রুতি \(\frac{200}{20} = 10\text{ m/s}\) ধ্রুব থাকে।
৪. যেহেতু ট্রেনটি ধ্রুব বেগে চলছে, তাই এটি একটি জড় প্রসঙ্গ কাঠামো, এবং ভূমি ও ট্রেন উভয় কাঠামো থেকে বলের ত্বরণ একই হবে।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
অতএব, ভূমি থেকে দেখলে প্রতি ১০ সেকেন্ড অন্তর বলের দ্রুতি পরিবর্তিত হয়, যেকোনো ২০ সেকেন্ড ব্যবধানে বলের গড় দ্রুতি নির্দিষ্ট থাকে এবং বলের ত্বরণ ট্রেন থেকে পরিমাপকৃত ত্বরণের সমান হয়।

answer.text: the direction of motion of the ball changes every 10 seconds.
average speed of ball over any 20 second interval is fixed.
the acceleration of ball is the same as from the train.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q01 - Graph with vanishing average velocity

questiontext.text:
Among the four graphs (Fig. 3.1), there is only one graph for which average velocity over the time interval \((0, T)\) can vanish for a suitably chosen \(T\). Which one is it?

नीचे दिए गए चार ग्राफों (चित्र 3.1) में से केवल एक ही ग्राफ ऐसा है जिसके लिए समय अंतराल \((0, T)\) में किसी उपयुक्त \(T\) के लिए औसत वेग शून्य हो सकता है। वह ग्राफ कौन-सा है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Four position-time (\(x\)-\(t\)) graphs are given for motion starting at \(t = 0\). We need to identify the graph for which the average velocity over \((0, T)\) can be zero for some \(T > 0\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Position \(x\) is plotted along the vertical axis and time \(t\) along the horizontal axis. The initial position is \(x(0)\) at \(t = 0\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Average velocity over the time interval \((0, T)\) is given by: \[v_{\text{avg}} = \frac{x(T) - x(0)}{T - 0} = \frac{x(T) - x(0)}{T}\] For \(v_{\text{avg}} = 0\) with \(T > 0\), we must have \(x(T) = x(0)\). Geometrically, a horizontal line drawn from \((0, x(0))\) parallel to the time axis must intersect the \(x\)-\(t\) curve at some \(t = T > 0\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
In the first graph, \(x\) starts at a negative value, increases, crosses zero, and remains positive, never returning to its initial negative value. In the third graph, \(x\) decreases monotonically from a positive value, so \(x(T) < x(0)\) for all \(T > 0\). In the fourth graph, \(x\) increases monotonically from zero, so \(x(T) > x(0)\) for all \(T > 0\). Only in the second graph does \(x\) start at a positive value \(x(0) > 0\), rise to a maximum, and then decrease below \(x(0)\), intersecting the horizontal line \(x = x(0)\) at some \(T > 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Since \(x(T) = x(0)\) at the intersection time \(T > 0\), the net displacement is zero and hence the average velocity vanishes. Thus, the graph that starts at a positive \(x(0)\), rises to a peak, and then falls below \(x(0)\) is the correct graph.

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
\(t = 0\) से प्रारंभ होने वाली गति के लिए चार स्थिति-समय (\(x\)-\(t\)) ग्राफ दिए गए हैं। हमें वह ग्राफ पहचानना है जिसके लिए किसी \(T > 0\) के लिए \((0, T)\) अंतराल में औसत वेग शून्य हो सकता है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
स्थिति \(x\) ऊर्ध्वाधर अक्ष पर और समय \(t\) क्षैतिज अक्ष पर अंकित है। \(t = 0\) पर प्रारंभिक स्थिति \(x(0)\) है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
समय अंतराल \((0, T)\) में औसत वेग का सूत्र है: \[v_{\text{avg}} = \frac{x(T) - x(0)}{T - 0} = \frac{x(T) - x(0)}{T}\] \(T > 0\) के साथ \(v_{\text{avg}} = 0\) होने के लिए \(x(T) = x(0)\) होना आवश्यक है। ज्यामितीय रूप से, \((0, x(0))\) से समय अक्ष के समानांतर खींची गई क्षैतिज रेखा को किसी \(t = T > 0\) पर \(x\)-\(t\) वक्र को प्रतिच्छेद करना चाहिए।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
पहले ग्राफ में \(x\) ऋणात्मक मान से शुरू होकर बढ़ता है, शून्य को पार करता है और धनात्मक बना रहता है, अतः कभी प्रारंभिक ऋणात्मक मान पर नहीं लौटता। तीसरे ग्राफ में \(x\) एक धनात्मक मान से एकदिष्ट रूप से घटता है, इसलिए सभी \(T > 0\) के लिए \(x(T) < x(0)\) रहता है। चौथे ग्राफ में \(x\) शून्य से एकदिष्ट रूप से बढ़ता है, इसलिए सभी \(T > 0\) के लिए \(x(T) > x(0)\) रहता है। केवल दूसरे ग्राफ में \(x\) एक धनात्मक मान \(x(0) > 0\) से शुरू होकर अधिकतम तक बढ़ता है और फिर \(x(0)\) से नीचे गिरता है, जिससे यह किसी \(T > 0\) पर \(x = x(0)\) की क्षैतिज रेखा को काटता है।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
चूँकि प्रतिच्छेदन समय \(T > 0\) पर \(x(T) = x(0)\) है, इसलिए कुल विस्थापन शून्य है और औसत वेग शून्य हो जाता है। अतः वह ग्राफ जो धनात्मक \(x(0)\) से शुरू होकर शिखर तक जाता है और फिर \(x(0)\) से नीचे गिरता है, सही उत्तर है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q02 - Signs of displacement velocity acceleration for lift

questiontext.text:
A lift is coming from 8th floor and is just about to reach 4th floor. Taking ground floor as origin and positive direction upwards for all quantities, which one of the following is correct?

एक लिफ्ट 8वीं मंजिल से आ रही है और 4वीं मंजिल पर पहुँचने ही वाली है। भूतल को मूल बिंदु तथा सभी राशियों के लिए ऊपर की दिशा को धनात्मक मानने पर, निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The lift moves from the 8th floor downwards and is just about to stop at the 4th floor.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The upward direction is taken as positive and the downward direction as negative. Following the standard convention for displacement from the starting floor (8th floor), downward displacement is negative.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Velocity \(v\) is in the direction of motion. When an object slows down (retards), its acceleration \(a\) is directed opposite to its velocity \(v\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since the lift is moving downwards from the 8th floor towards the 4th floor, its displacement \(x\) is downwards, so \(x < 0\). Its velocity is also directed downwards, so \(v < 0\). Because it is just about to reach the 4th floor and stop, it is decelerating; therefore, the acceleration acts in the upward direction, giving \(a > 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Combining the signs, we obtain \(x < 0\), \(v < 0\), and \(a > 0\).

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
लिफ्ट 8वीं मंजिल से नीचे की ओर आ रही है और 4वीं मंजिल पर रुकने ही वाली है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
ऊपर की दिशा को धनात्मक और नीचे की दिशा को ऋणात्मक माना गया है। प्रारंभिक मंजिल (8वीं मंजिल) से विस्थापन के लिए नीचे की ओर विस्थापन ऋणात्मक लिया जाता है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
वेग \(v\) गति की दिशा में होता है। जब कोई वस्तु मंदित होती है (धीमी होती है), तो उसका त्वरण \(a\) उसके वेग \(v\) की विपरीत दिशा में होता है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
चूँकि लिफ्ट 8वीं मंजिल से 4वीं मंजिल की ओर नीचे आ रही है, इसका विस्थापन \(x\) नीचे की ओर है, इसलिए \(x < 0\) है। इसका वेग भी नीचे की ओर है, अतः \(v < 0\) है। चूँकि यह 4वीं मंजिल पर पहुँचकर रुकने ही वाली है, यह मंदित हो रही है; इसलिए त्वरण ऊपर की दिशा में कार्य करता है, जिससे \(a > 0\) प्राप्त होता है।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
सभी चिह्नों को संयोजित करने पर हमें \(x < 0\), \(v < 0\), और \(a > 0\) प्राप्त होता है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q03 - Bounds on displacement from bounded speed

questiontext.text:
In one dimensional motion, instantaneous speed \(v\) satisfies \(0 \le v < v_0\).

एकविमीय गति में, तात्क्षणिक चाल \(v\) संबंध \(0 \le v < v_0\) को संतुष्ट करती है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
For a particle in one-dimensional motion, the instantaneous speed satisfies \(0 \le v < v_0\) over a time interval \(T\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Motion can occur in either the positive or negative direction along the line. Thus, the instantaneous velocity \(v_x\) satisfies \(-v_0 < v_x < v_0\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Displacement \(x\) in time \(T\) is the time integral of instantaneous velocity: \[x = \int_0^T v_x \, dt\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since \(-v_0 < v_x < v_0\) at every instant, integrating over the interval \(0\) to \(T\) gives: \[\int_0^T (-v_0) \, dt < \int_0^T v_x \, dt < \int_0^T v_0 \, dt \implies -v_0 T < x < v_0 T\] Displacement can be negative if the particle moves in the negative direction, acceleration can be negative when slowing down or speeding up in the negative direction, and turning points can exist where \(v = 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The bounds have units of length and hold regardless of direction changes. Therefore, the displacement \(x\) in time \(T\) satisfies \(-v_0 T < x < v_0 T\).

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
एकविमीय गति कर रहे कण के लिए, समय अंतराल \(T\) में तात्क्षणिक चाल \(0 \le v < v_0\) को संतुष्ट करती है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
गति रेखा के अनुदिश धनात्मक या ऋणात्मक किसी भी दिशा में हो सकती है। अतः तात्क्षणिक वेग \(v_x\) संबंध \(-v_0 < v_x < v_0\) को संतुष्ट करता है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
समय \(T\) में विस्थापन \(x\), तात्क्षणिक वेग का समय समाकल होता है: \[x = \int_0^T v_x \, dt\]

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
चूँकि प्रत्येक क्षण \(-v_0 < v_x < v_0\) है, इसलिए \(0\) से \(T\) तक समाकलन करने पर प्राप्त होता है: \[\int_0^T (-v_0) \, dt < \int_0^T v_x \, dt < \int_0^T v_0 \, dt \implies -v_0 T < x < v_0 T\] यदि कण ऋणात्मक दिशा में चलता है तो विस्थापन ऋणात्मक हो सकता है, त्वरण भी ऋणात्मक हो सकता है, और जहाँ \(v = 0\) हो वहाँ मोड़ बिंदु (turning points) भी हो सकते हैं।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
सीमाओं की इकाई लंबाई की है और ये दिशा परिवर्तन से स्वतंत्र हैं। अतः समय \(T\) में विस्थापन \(x\), \(-v_0 T < x < v_0 T\) को संतुष्ट करता है।

answer.text: The displacement in time \(T\) must always take non-negative values.
The displacement \(x\) in time \(T\) satisfies \(-v_0 T < x < v_0 T\).
The acceleration is always a non-negative number.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q04 - Average speed for equal half distances

questiontext.text:
A vehicle travels half the distance \(L\) with speed \(V_1\) and the other half with speed \(V_2\), then its average speed is

एक वाहन आधी दूरी \(L/2\) को \(V_1\) चाल से तथा शेष आधी दूरी को \(V_2\) चाल से तय करता है, तो इसकी औसत चाल है

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Total distance \(= L\). First half distance \(= \frac{L}{2}\) is covered at speed \(V_1\), and the second half distance \(= \frac{L}{2}\) is covered at speed \(V_2\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Speeds \(V_1\) and \(V_2\) are positive scalar quantities.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
\[\text{Average speed} = \frac{\text{Total distance}}{\text{Total time}}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Time taken for the first half: \(t_1 = \frac{L/2}{V_1} = \frac{L}{2V_1}\). Time taken for the second half: \(t_2 = \frac{L/2}{V_2} = \frac{L}{2V_2}\). Total time: \[T = t_1 + t_2 = \frac{L}{2V_1} + \frac{L}{2V_2} = \frac{L(V_1 + V_2)}{2V_1 V_2}\] Average speed: \[V_{\text{avg}} = \frac{L}{T} = \frac{L}{\frac{L(V_1 + V_2)}{2V_1 V_2}} = \frac{2V_1 V_2}{V_1 + V_2}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
If \(V_1 = V_2 = V\), the formula reduces to \(V\), which is consistent. Thus, the average speed is \(\frac{2V_1 V_2}{V_1 + V_2}\).

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
कुल दूरी \(= L\)। पहली आधी दूरी \(= \frac{L}{2}\) चाल \(V_1\) से और दूसरी आधी दूरी \(= \frac{L}{2}\) चाल \(V_2\) से तय की जाती है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
चाल \(V_1\) और \(V_2\) धनात्मक अदिश राशियाँ हैं।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
\[\text{औसत चाल} = \frac{\text{कुल दूरी}}{\text{कुल समय}}\]

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
पहली आधी दूरी तय करने में लगा समय: \(t_1 = \frac{L/2}{V_1} = \frac{L}{2V_1}\)। दूसरी आधी दूरी तय करने में लगा समय: \(t_2 = \frac{L/2}{V_2} = \frac{L}{2V_2}\)। कुल समय: \[T = t_1 + t_2 = \frac{L}{2V_1} + \frac{L}{2V_2} = \frac{L(V_1 + V_2)}{2V_1 V_2}\] औसत चाल: \[V_{\text{avg}} = \frac{L}{T} = \frac{L}{\frac{L(V_1 + V_2)}{2V_1 V_2}} = \frac{2V_1 V_2}{V_1 + V_2}\]

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
यदि \(V_1 = V_2 = V\) हो, तो सूत्र से \(V\) प्राप्त होता है, जो संगत है। अतः औसत चाल \(\frac{2V_1 V_2}{V_1 + V_2}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q05 - Distance covered with direction reversal

questiontext.text:
The displacement of a particle is given by \(x = (t - 2)^2\) where \(x\) is in metres and \(t\) in seconds. The distance covered by the particle in first \(4\) seconds is

एक कण का विस्थापन \(x = (t - 2)^2\) द्वारा दिया गया है, जहाँ \(x\) मीटर में और \(t\) सेकंड में है। प्रथम \(4\) सेकंड में कण द्वारा तय की गई दूरी है

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Position function: \(x(t) = (t - 2)^2\text{ m}\), time interval: \(t = 0\text{ s}\) to \(t = 4\text{ s}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Distance is the total path length travelled, regardless of direction, so we must check whether the particle reverses direction during the interval.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Instantaneous velocity is \(v = \frac{dx}{dt}\). Distance covered in an interval is \(\int |v| \, dt\), or the sum of magnitudes of displacements between turning points.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Differentiating \(x(t)\): \[v(t) = \frac{dx}{dt} = 2(t - 2)\] Setting \(v(t) = 0\) gives \(t = 2\text{ s}\), which lies within \((0, 4)\text{ s}\). Now evaluate \(x\) at \(t = 0\), \(t = 2\), and \(t = 4\): \[x(0) = (0 - 2)^2 = 4\text{ m}\] \[x(2) = (2 - 2)^2 = 0\text{ m}\] \[x(4) = (4 - 2)^2 = 4\text{ m}\] Distance from \(t = 0\) to \(t = 2\text{ s}\): \(|x(2) - x(0)| = |0 - 4| = 4\text{ m}\). Distance from \(t = 2\) to \(t = 4\text{ s}\): \(|x(4) - x(2)| = |4 - 0| = 4\text{ m}\). Total distance \(= 4\text{ m} + 4\text{ m} = 8\text{ m}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Although net displacement is \(x(4) - x(0) = 0\), the particle reverses direction at \(t = 2\text{ s}\), so the total distance covered is \(8\text{ m}\).

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
स्थिति फलन: \(x(t) = (t - 2)^2\text{ m}\), समय अंतराल: \(t = 0\text{ s}\) से \(t = 4\text{ s}\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
दूरी, दिशा की परवाह किए बिना तय की गई कुल पथ लंबाई होती है, इसलिए हमें यह जाँचना होगा कि क्या कण इस अंतराल में अपनी दिशा बदलता है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
तात्क्षणिक वेग \(v = \frac{dx}{dt}\) है। किसी अंतराल में तय की गई दूरी \(\int |v| \, dt\) या मोड़ बिंदुओं के बीच विस्थापनों के परिमाणों का योग होती है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
\(x(t)\) का अवकलन करने पर: \[v(t) = \frac{dx}{dt} = 2(t - 2)\] \(v(t) = 0\) रखने पर \(t = 2\text{ s}\) प्राप्त होता है, जो \((0, 4)\text{ s}\) के भीतर स्थित है। अब \(t = 0\), \(t = 2\), और \(t = 4\) पर \(x\) का मान ज्ञात करते हैं: \[x(0) = (0 - 2)^2 = 4\text{ m}\] \[x(2) = (2 - 2)^2 = 0\text{ m}\] \[x(4) = (4 - 2)^2 = 4\text{ m}\] \(t = 0\) से \(t = 2\text{ s}\) तक दूरी: \(|x(2) - x(0)| = |0 - 4| = 4\text{ m}\)। \(t = 2\) से \(t = 4\text{ s}\) तक दूरी: \(|x(4) - x(2)| = |4 - 0| = 4\text{ m}\)। कुल दूरी \(= 4\text{ m} + 4\text{ m} = 8\text{ m}\)।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
यद्यपि कुल विस्थापन \(x(4) - x(0) = 0\) है, कण \(t = 2\text{ s}\) पर अपनी दिशा बदलता है, अतः तय की गई कुल दूरी \(8\text{ m}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q06 - Time to walk up moving escalator

questiontext.text:
At a metro station, a girl walks up a stationary escalator in time \(t_1\). If she remains stationary on the escalator, then the escalator take her up in time \(t_2\). The time taken by her to walk up on the moving escalator will be

एक मेट्रो स्टेशन पर एक लड़की स्थिर एस्केलेटर पर चलकर \(t_1\) समय में ऊपर जाती है। यदि वह एस्केलेटर पर स्थिर खड़ी रहे, तो एस्केलेटर उसे \(t_2\) समय में ऊपर ले जाता है। चलती हुई एस्केलेटर पर चलकर ऊपर जाने में उसे कितना समय लगेगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Time to walk up a stationary escalator \(= t_1\). Time for the moving escalator to carry her up when she stands still \(= t_2\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Let the length of the escalator be \(L\). Both her walking speed relative to the escalator and the escalator's speed relative to the ground are directed upwards along the escalator.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
When she walks up the moving escalator, her speed relative to the ground is the sum of her walking speed relative to the escalator (\(v_g\)) and the escalator's speed (\(v_e\)): \[v = v_g + v_e\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Speed of the girl relative to the escalator: \(v_g = \frac{L}{t_1}\). Speed of the escalator relative to the ground: \(v_e = \frac{L}{t_2}\). Net upward speed relative to the ground: \[v = \frac{L}{t_1} + \frac{L}{t_2} = L\left(\frac{t_1 + t_2}{t_1 t_2}\right)\] Therefore, the time \(t\) taken to cover length \(L\) is: \[t = \frac{L}{v} = \frac{t_1 t_2}{t_2 + t_1}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The result has dimensions of time and is less than both \(t_1\) and \(t_2\), as expected. Thus, the time taken is \(\frac{t_1 t_2}{t_2 + t_1}\).

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
स्थिर एस्केलेटर पर चलकर ऊपर जाने का समय \(= t_1\)। स्थिर खड़े रहने पर चलती एस्केलेटर द्वारा ऊपर ले जाने का समय \(= t_2\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
मान लीजिए एस्केलेटर की लंबाई \(L\) है। एस्केलेटर के सापेक्ष लड़की की चाल और जमीन के सापेक्ष एस्केलेटर की चाल दोनों एस्केलेटर के अनुदिश ऊपर की ओर हैं।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
जब वह चलती हुई एस्केलेटर पर ऊपर चलती है, तो जमीन के सापेक्ष उसकी चाल, एस्केलेटर के सापेक्ष उसकी चाल (\(v_g\)) और एस्केलेटर की चाल (\(v_e\)) के योग के बराबर होती है: \[v = v_g + v_e\]

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
एस्केलेटर के सापेक्ष लड़की की चाल: \(v_g = \frac{L}{t_1}\)। जमीन के सापेक्ष एस्केलेटर की चाल: \(v_e = \frac{L}{t_2}\)। जमीन के सापेक्ष कुल ऊपर की ओर चाल: \[v = \frac{L}{t_1} + \frac{L}{t_2} = L\left(\frac{t_1 + t_2}{t_1 t_2}\right)\] अतः लंबाई \(L\) तय करने में लगा समय \(t\) होगा: \[t = \frac{L}{v} = \frac{t_1 t_2}{t_2 + t_1}\]

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
परिणाम की विमा समय की है और यह \(t_1\) तथा \(t_2\) दोनों से कम है, जो कि अपेक्षित है। अतः लगा समय \(\frac{t_1 t_2}{t_2 + t_1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q07 - Linear graph of quantity A versus B

questiontext.text:
The variation of quantity \(A\) with quantity \(B\), plotted in Fig. 3.2 describes the motion of a particle in a straight line.

चित्र 3.2 में खींचा गया राशि \(A\) का राशि \(B\) के साथ परिवर्तन एक सरल रेखा में कण की गति को दर्शाता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The given graph shows a straight line with a positive slope and a positive intercept on the \(A\)-axis, so \(A = mB + c\) with \(m > 0\) and \(c > 0\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
We test standard kinematic relationships for straight-line motion where \(B\) represents time \(t\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For uniform motion (constant velocity \(v \neq 0\)): \(x = x_0 + vt\). For uniformly accelerated motion (constant acceleration \(a \neq 0\)): \(v = u + at\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
If \(B\) represents time \(t\), then \(A\) increases linearly with time. - If motion is uniform, velocity is constant, so a velocity-time graph would be a horizontal line (\(m = 0\)), which contradicts the positive slope. However, displacement \(x = x_0 + vt\) is linear with positive slope when \(v > 0\) and \(x_0 > 0\). - If motion is uniformly accelerated, velocity \(v = u + at\) is linear with positive slope when \(a > 0\) and \(u > 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Thus, quantity \(B\) may represent time, quantity \(A\) is displacement if motion is uniform, and quantity \(A\) is velocity if motion is uniformly accelerated.

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
दिया गया ग्राफ धनात्मक ढाल और \(A\)-अक्ष पर धनात्मक अंतःखंड वाली एक सरल रेखा दर्शाता है, अर्थात \(A = mB + c\) जहाँ \(m > 0\) और \(c > 0\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
हम सरल रेखीय गति के मानक गतिकी संबंधों की जाँच करते हैं जहाँ \(B\) समय \(t\) को दर्शाता है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
